posts.title: Rippling treats payroll errors as feature requests
posts.description: tl;dr: Rippling does not ensure HSA contributions and deposits actually match, leading to a situation where you may have money withheld from your paycheck that doesn’t actually get deposited into your HSA. If you use Rippling and have made manual HSA contributions during the year, go audit your contributions and make sure they match the deposits into your HSA account.
